title: City Sightseeing Philadelphia HOHO Bus Tour + Bookable Extras
includes: Audio guide commentary in 12 languages + headphones
Stops near all the major sights
1, 2 or 3-day hop-on hop-off bus tour (depending on option selected)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Season: All Year Round excluding Thanksgiving and 25 December
Mobile and printed paper vouchers are accepted on this tour. All vouchers for the bus tour must be redeemed at 21 South 5th Street
With your voucher, enjoy flexible access for up to 12 months from the travel date you select at check-out.
Please note, the Bus Tour and Night Tour tickets are all sold separately so the appropriate ticket will need to be selected
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the countless sights Philadelphia has to offer on this thoroughly enjoyable hop-on hop-off bus tour! You'll see all of Philly's iconic landmarks in your own time, including Love Park, Penn's Landing, Philadelphia Zoo and much more! On this 1, 2 or 3 day double-decker tour, you can hop-on and off as many times as you want, or stay on the bus for a full loop.

Choose a 1.5 hour Night Tour to experience the dazzling lights of Philadelphia under the starry sky on a Panoramic bus tour. On this tour you can experience Philadelphia's most iconic sights such as Independence Hall, the famous Rocky Steps and Liberty Bell (must be booked separately from the hop-on hop-off bus tour).
